title: Remote Work Policy — Interns and Graduate Hires
content: Interns and graduate hires joining Acme Corp are expected to work from the office five days per week during their first three months. This onboarding period is designed to maximise learning through in-person mentoring and observation. After successful completion of the onboarding period, interns and graduate hires transition to the standard remote work entitlement for individual contributors. Exceptions for the onboarding period require sign-off from the relevant department head and HR. This policy does not apply to employees who have previously completed an internship with Acme Corp.
